code: import axios from"axios";const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"http://127.0.0.1:5000";const API=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout:10000});export const analyzePayload=async payload=>{const response=await API.post("/api/v1/analyze",payload);return response.data;};export const analyzeBarcode=async ean=>{const response=await API.post("/api/v1/analyze",{ean});return response.data;};export const fetchProductInfo=async barcode=>{const response=await API.get("/api/v1/product/".concat(barcode));return response.data;};export const fetchAuditQueue=async()=>{const response=await API.get("/api/v1/audit/unmapped");return response.data;};export const checkHealth=async()=>{const response=await API.get("/api/health");return response.data;};export default API;
